summary: GPU parts of V details, one per part content, kept while any V shows them and for 30 s after, so unchanged and preloaded parts cost nothing.

x-friction.gap: A part stays while any V shows it and for 30 s after its last use, so a flip back or a click after a hover finds it; today another V clears the pool by hand.
x-friction.closes: Demand that lingers for a set time after its last consumer, with host objects made per key and collected after.
